title: Xinchuang ARM64 portability
highlights: Linux ARM64 assets are now built on the glibc 2.17 baseline (manylinux2014_aarch64 container) with the emulated-TLS Termux contract preserved, so they run on Xinchuang machines shipping glibc 2.23/2.28 as well as on Termux
improvements: Sync upstream master, including async per-platform release publication and faster compatibility builds
fixes: Make the standard Linux x86_64/ARM64 release artifacts run in Xinchuang environments (glibc 2.23/2.28); the previous ARM64 asset linked against glibc 2.39 and could not start there
